title: 2521. Distinct Prime Factors of Product of Array

examples.explanation: The product of all the elements in nums is: 2 * 4 * 3 * 7 * 10 * 6 = 10080 = 25 * 32 * 5 * 7. There are 4 distinct prime factors so we return 4.
The product of all the elements in nums is: 2 * 4 * 8 * 16 = 1024 = 210. There is 1 distinct prime factor so we return 1.
